title: Generic-field descent of a cyclic higher direct image witness
statement: For positive n and d dividing n, a nonzero cyclic higher direct image over an algebraically closed extension of an algebraically closed function field descends to the function field.

proof.text: Compute higher direct images by sheafified cohomology presheaves on affine etale objects; algebraically closed extension invariance gives local bijectivity, hence an isomorphism after sheafification and preservation of nonvanishing.
